prompt: Compose a COMPLETE original 30-second instrumental micro-score for a short product promotional video. Exactly one short cue, not a full-length song. Sound: tactile acoustic minimalism; interlocking wooden percussion and witty plucked melody. Instruments: woodblocks, pizzicato strings, marimba, brushed snare. Tempo 120 BPM, 4/4. Main hook: a repeated note followed by a playful octave leap. [00:00] Immediate confident musical hook and beat within the first half-second, no intro or fade-in. [00:02] Establish a catchy clear groove with space for visual edits. [00:16] One crisp stop-and-restart or timbral switch, then a slightly fuller reprise. [00:26] A concise resolving fill. [00:29] A decisive final musical button for a logo reveal. [00:30] End completely after the brief natural decay. Total duration 30 seconds. Maintain the hook throughout, usable from any downbeat. Punchy but not harsh, audible melody and rhythm on phone speakers, controlled sub-bass, no long riser, no slow build or repeated sections. Instrumental only. No vocals, choir, humming, singing, speech, lyrics or vocal samples. Do not imitate any artist, existing song or brand jingle.

description.en: An upbeat, playful, and slightly retro orchestral pop track with a clear, memorable melody, featuring pizzicato strings, bright brass, and a driving rhythm section.
description.zh: 一首欢快、俏皮且略带复古感的管弦流行乐曲，旋律清晰动听，以拨弦乐器、明亮的铜管乐和强劲的节奏部分为特色。

description.en: A playful and whimsical cartoon-style instrumental track featuring a prominent glockenspiel melody, a walking bassline, and light, bouncy percussion. It evokes a cheerful, retro, and lighthearted atmosphere, reminiscent of classic animation or children's media.
